explanation: There is no Portuguese seat in the European Parliament before 1 January 1986. For the first eighteen months the Assembly of the Republic appointed delegates from among its own members to the twenty-four seats accession created. The ballot of 19 July 1987 is the first time voters elected those seats, and it exists because of the accession and for no other reason. The edge gives the atlas that interval, a year and a half in which the country was represented in a parliament its voters had not chosen.
